BEGIN;

-- External immutable-catalog identity. It deliberately has no cross-service FK.
ALTER TABLE student_practice_task
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS practice_task_solution_variant_id uuid NULL;

ALTER TABLE student_practice_task
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_practice_task_student_id_practice_task_id_key;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS student_practice_task_student_id_practice_task_id_key;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_legacy_unique
    ON student_practice_task(student_id, practice_task_id)
    WHERE practice_task_revision_id IS NULL
      AND practice_task_solution_variant_id IS NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_revision_variant_unique
    ON student_practice_task(student_id, practice_task_revision_id, practice_task_solution_variant_id)
    WHERE practice_task_revision_id IS NOT NULL
      AND practice_task_solution_variant_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_solution_variant
    ON student_practice_task(practice_task_solution_variant_id)
    WHERE practice_task_solution_variant_id IS NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
